Overview Application

We believe that the way people interact with their finances will drastically improve in
the next few years. We're dedicated to empowering this transformation by building
the tools and experiences that thousands of developers use to create their own
products. Plaid powers the tools millions of people rely on to live a healthier financial
life. We work with thousands of companies like Venmo, Sofi, several of the Fortune
500, and many of the largest banks to make it easy for people to connect their
financial accounts to the apps and services they want to use. Plaid’s network covers
12,000 financial institutions across the US, Canada, UK and Europe. Founded in 2013,
the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Seattle,
Washington D.C., Raleigh, London, and Amsterdam.

About the Team

The Fraud team is building the largest network of trusted identities in the US. We help
customers onboard legitimate users and stop bad actors before they cause
downstream harm. Our products span the risk lifecycle: Identity Verification and
Monitor for onboarding and compliance, and Protect, our fraud intelligence platform.

We are extending that network to Al agents. Agents are starting to open accounts,
link accounts, move money, and transfer between wallets for consumers. The
protocols forming around them standardize how an agent identifies itself and what it
may do, and leave the question of whether to trust it to the business on the receiving
end. Agent Trust, our Know Your Agent (KYA) product, answers it, on top of the
identity, consent, and risk infrastructure Plaid already runs.

You will take over Agent Trust: the decision on whether an action an Al agent takes on
a financial account can be trusted. You will define how Plaid identifies agents, verifies
the people behind them, and evaluates what they are authorized to do, and how that
connects to portable identity, reusable KYC, and consumer permissions. You will sell
that decision to financial institutions and to Plaid customers, and you will carry Plaid’s
requirements into the standards bodies shaping this space, with the fraud engineering
and data teams behind you.

« Own the vision, strategy, roadmap, and OKRs for Agent Trust. Decide what Plaid
offers, to whom, and how it is packaged and priced.

« Define how Plaid identifies agents, verifies the humans behind them, and
evaluates what they are allowed to do, for new accounts and existing ones.

« Connect Agent Trust to portable identity, reusable KYC, and consumer
permission management, with the product teams that own those surfaces.

« Work directly with financial institutions and Plaid customers as the product
expert: discovery, design partnerships, and GTM enablement.

« Represent Plaid’s product requirements in the industry groups and protocol
working groups writing the specs for agent identity and authorization, with
Partnerships and Legal.

« Partner with data science and engineering on what the product needs: signals,
labels, success metrics, and the requirements that tie them together.

Qualifications:

« 4+ years of product management or equivalent product ownership, with
meaningful time in fraud, identity, authentication, or payments risk

« Hands-on depth in identity and authorization protocols (OAuth 2.x and OIDC,
FIDO and WebAuthn, FDX or Open Banking consent), or in bot, device, and
agent detection systems

« Track record of growing a new product line, from early design partners and first
customers to repeatable sales

« Experience building with and selling to enterprise customers or financial
institutions

« Clear writing, and the ability to translate between protocol engineers, data
scientists, GTM, and executives

mission, we seek to build a diverse team of driven individuals who care deeply about
making the financial ecosystem more equitable. We recognize that strong
